name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a PennyLane program with a QNode t
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a PennyLane program with a QNode that applies RX(0.488) and RY(1.245) to one qubit and returns <Z>. Print the result and the analytic value cos(0.488)*cos(1.245). Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
